name: photomatch-ai
description: PhotoMatch AI — guests find their own event photos with a selfie, delivered on Telegram or WhatsApp.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run worker -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,worker "npm run start -w apps/api" "npm run worker:start -w apps/api"
